camel_example: aliyun hbr UpdateClientSettings --region cn-hangzhou --DataNetworkType VPC --MaxCpuCore 1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-000000000000000000000' --AlertOnPartialComplete false --ProxyPassword 000000 --ProxyUser user --VaultId 'v-000000000000000000000' --UseHttps false --MaxWorker 1 --DataProxySetting USE_CONTROL_PROXY --ClientId 'c-000000000000000000000' --ProxyHost '192.168.11.100' --ProxyPort 3128 --MaxMemory 4096
description_en: Updates the configuration of a backup client
description_zh: 更新一个备份客户端的配置
kebab_example: aliyun hbr update-client-settings --use-https false --vault-id v-000000000000000000000 --client-id c-000000000000000000000 --data-network-type VPC --max-cpu-core 1 --max-worker 1 --data-proxy-setting USE_CONTROL_PROXY --proxy-host 192.168.11.100 --proxy-port 3128 --proxy-user user --proxy-password 000000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000000000000 --max-memory 4096 --alert-on-partial-complete false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateClientSettings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use HTTPS to transmit data plane data.

true: Uses HTTPS for transmission.
false: Uses HTTP for transmission
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用HTTPS传输数据面数据。

true表示使用HTTPS传输。
false表示使用HTTP传输
parameters.name: use_https

parameters.help_en: The backup vault ID. This parameter is required for legacy clients
parameters.help_zh: 备份仓库ID。旧版客户端时该参数必须配置
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The data plane access point type. Valid values:
PUBLIC: public network
VPC: VPC network
CLASSIC: classic network
parameters.help_zh:
数据面数据接入点类型。取值范围：
PUBLIC：公网
VPC：VPC网络
CLASSIC：经典网络
parameters.name: data_network_type

parameters.help_en: The number of CPU cores used by a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 单个备份任务使用的CPU核数，0表示不限制
parameters.name: max_cpu_core

parameters.help_en: The number of concurrent workers for a single backup job. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 单个备份任务并发工作数量，0表示不限制
parameters.name: max_worker

parameters.help_en:
The data plane proxy setting. Valid values:
DISABLE: does not use a proxy.
USE_CONTROL_PROXY (default): uses the same configuration as the control plane.
CUSTOM: uses a custom configuration (HTTP protocol)
parameters.help_zh:
数据面代理设置。取值范围：
DISABLE：不使用代理
USE_CONTROL_PROXY（默认）：与控制面配置相同
CUSTOM：自定义配置（HTTP协议）
parameters.name: data_proxy_setting

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the custom data plane proxy server host
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器主机IP地址
parameters.name: proxy_host

parameters.help_en: The port of the custom data plane proxy server host
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器主机端口
parameters.name: proxy_port

parameters.help_en: The username of the custom data plane proxy server
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器用户名
parameters.name: proxy_user

parameters.help_en: The password of the custom data plane proxy server
parameters.help_zh: 自定义数据面代理服务器密码
parameters.name: proxy_password

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory that the client can use, in bytes. Only version 2.13.0 and later are supported
parameters.help_zh: 客户端能够使用的最大内存，单位是bytes。仅支持2.13.0及以上版本
parameters.name: max_memory

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to trigger an alert for partially completed jobs. This parameter takes effect only for local File Backup and ECS File Backup Essential Edition
parameters.help_zh: 是否针对部分完成任务告警，仅针对本地文件备份和ECS文件备份标准版生效
parameters.name: alert_on_partial_complete
